label: Pre-encounter — the alarm in the sanctuary

recentEvents.value: The gate bell has sounded; an armed stranger walks the ambassador's road and does not answer hailings.
Tomb attendants are carrying the youngest names deeper into the sanctuary, ledger by ledger.

unresolvedConflicts.value: An armed stranger who understands every word and keeps coming.

temporaryObjective.value: Persuade the envoy to turn back before his boots reach the burial chambers.

notes: He still believes any listener can be taught reverence (profile mainFlaw), so communication is attempted first — the phase-one pressure entry, not naivety.
